case_desc.description: One line: the parties, and what the construction dispute was about.

disputed.description: The listed clauses the court construed. An empty list is a valid answer when the construed language is not among the clauses shown.

contract_id.description: The contract_id whose clause list this id comes from, copied exactly from that document's START marker.

clause_id.description: The id of the clause, taken from that contract's clause list, e.g. "c042". This is the only way to name a clause: you cannot report a line range, and an id absent from that contract's list is rejected.

issues.description: One entry per DISTINCT defect the court construed in this clause. Two entries only where the court construed two different problems; a defect the court returns to later in the opinion is still one issue. Most clauses have exactly one.

risk_type.description: The ONE risk type code this issue falls under. A CODE, e.g. "1.1" — not the Westlaw key label such as "k152", and no brackets. It must be one the task lists as a candidate for this case.

issue.description: One sentence naming the specific defect the court construed: which words, and what was wrong with them. Concrete enough that a different defect in the same clause would need a different sentence. Your own words — do not quote the opinion at length.

opinion_comment_start_line.description: First line in the OPINION of the passage where the court construes THIS issue.

opinion_comment_end_line.description: Last line in the OPINION of that passage.

unlocated.description: Anything the court construed that no listed clause contains. Empty when there is nothing. Use this rather than reporting the nearest similar clause.

description.description: What the court was construing, in your own words.

why.description: Why it is not in the lists, as far as you can tell: the agreement was not filed, the page is missing, the clause list skipped it, or you cannot say.

opinion_comment_start_line.description: First line in the OPINION showing the court construing it.

opinion_comment_end_line.description: Last line in the OPINION of that passage.
